title: deutzia × rosea f. floribunda
intro: Deutzia × rosea f. floribunda, commonly known as the 'Pride of Rochford', is a flowering plant that belongs to the Hydrangeaceae family, native to China and cultivated in many parts of the world for its ornamental value. The plant is known to have various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Deutzia × rosea f. floribunda include its potential to act as an anti-anxiety and anti-depressant agent, due to its ability to promote relaxation and reduce stress levels. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
